Get Now 🏼
Mvua ya Baraka is a heartfelt collaboration between Zuchu and Diamond Platnumz, inspired by their journey into parenthood. Built around gratitude, faith and answered prayers, the song captures the joy of receiving a blessing that changes your life.
While deeply personal, its message is a celebration of new beginnings, family, love, success and every moment that feels like an answered prayer.
